issues.title: Seller-reported clogged catalyst without measured location or upstream cause
issues.cause: Unknown until direct diagnosis: potential misfire, mixture, physical substrate failure or downstream restriction.
symptoms: Seller describes a blocked catalytic converter
Vehicle may be non-running; no preserved freeze-frame or pressure measurement yet
issues.diagnosis_summary: Record genuine VIN/emissions label, DTCs, prior misfire/fueling evidence, last running conditions, professional restriction test location and method, structural condition.
issues.correction_summary: No replacement authorization until restriction and root cause are measured; qualified shop quote and legal US/NY converter applicability first.
limits: No backpressure value or engine health conclusion
Does not authorize catalyst deletion or used replacement

issues.title: EVAP purge leak or integrity fault can confound mixture and engine assessment
issues.cause: Factory-documented purge valve fault, EVAP system leak, shut-off valve or pressure sensor can produce differing diagnostic branches.
symptoms: Fuel correction may be affected by active purge
issues.diagnosis_summary: Preserve DTC and freeze frame, confirm equipment actually fitted and follow correct Saab T7 year-specific fault tree.
issues.correction_summary: Repair verified leaky hose/valve/sensor route only after controlled diagnosis; not blanket component replacement.
limits: Do not open or pressurize the fuel system casually

issues.title: Downstream oxygen sensor electrical code is not an exhaust restriction measurement
issues.cause: O2S 2 high voltage may arise from lead or sensor electrical fault in original P0138 manual.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Inspect sensor connector and harness per factory diagnostics, preserving DTCs and avoiding connector spray.
issues.correction_summary: Correct proven wiring or sensor failure; physical catalyst restriction requires separate proof.
limits: Not evidence that converter itself is blocked
No sensor part number or VIN-approved replacement identified
